published_ranges._print_speed: Medium (product page); 'compatible for printing at high speed'
published_ranges._notes: Transparent PETG. Page: flow ~100%, retraction ~5 mm. Specific gravity 1.27 g/cc (ASTM D792) per TDS v4.

conflicts: TDS v4 (9 March 2016) prints print temperature 195-225C; current product page gives 235-260C (kept, as 195-225C is implausible for this PETG and looks like a TDS template error).
